items.note: Serpent (sarpabandha) inscription at Un, Chaubara Dera No. 1: an alphabetical chart with conjugational terminations on a single serpent, 80 by 61 cm; a comparison for nāgabandha lettering (Un, not Udaypur).
A second small inscription in the Un temple names the Paramāra king Udayāditya (Udayāditya-devasya); a third gives Sanskrit grammatical rules (Un, not Udaypur).
